commit.message:
feat: promote QA-passed MS assets to post-attempt display posture (#1492)

Promote only the controlled page-level MS screenshots that passed #1491's Codex
worker visual QA into post-attempt self-assessment display eligibility, and
record the product display receipt that gates it.

Promotion is a product decision and is recorded on two axes that are never
collapsed into one another. `product_display_policy_posture` says what the
product will show and where; `legal_authorization_status` says what we can
prove about the source. `product_allowed_with_takedown` is not a licence.

No artifact in this repository establishes a licence or an explicit permission
for the 9709 mark schemes, so `licensed` and `explicit_permission` stay
unwritable and 413 assets sit at `rights_unknown`. The 11 pages whose source
carries a third-party redistribution band that declares the questions modified
are `rights_blocked`. Because nothing is legally authorized, promotion lands in
a closed scope: `internal_only`, `requires_login`, never indexable.
`public_launch` is `future_authorization_required`, and the validator fails if
any public scope is granted without an authorization artifact.

An asset reaches a student only when it carries `visual_qa_pass` and the row it
is revealed for carries `row_page_match_pass`. That yields 25 eligible page
assets across 6 documents and 28 allowed source reveals, each with a disable
switch and a takedown handle. A clean render whose locator was never verified
against its question row is `internal_only` rather than `blocked` — the pixels
are fine, the aim is unproven — which is where the other 382 QA-passed assets
sit.

Everything else stays hidden or falls back to the structured explanation: 6
wrong-page front-matter renders, the 11 watermarked pages, and the 2895
document-only, ambiguous and manual-review rows. 607 page rows that failed
promotion fall back rather than reveal. 11 of the 28 allowed reveals share a
page with a neighbouring question's answers and keep their exposure warning.

#1458 recorded `blocked` for these assets on the basis that no student-display
legal authorization artifact exists. That basis still holds, and it is why the
scope here is closed: nothing becomes publicly visible and the legal field is
untouched. Widening past a closed scope re-enters that blocker.

official_authorization_claimed_count, automatic_scoring_claim_count and
smart_mark_readiness_claim_count are all 0. No screenshots, no crops, no OCR,
no VLM, no external model call, no production writes.

Closes #1492
